name: ZMYND11-related developmental delay-speech delay-seizures-behavioral abnormalities-craniofacial dysmorphism syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed criteria for ZMYND11-related neurodevelopmental disorder

criteria.description: Global developmental delay including speech delay
Presence of seizures or epilepsy of variable severity
Characteristic craniofacial features including microcephaly, prominent nasal bridge, and thin upper lip
Behavioral abnormalities such as autistic features, hyperactivity, or anxiety
Identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in ZMYND11 gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of global developmental delay with speech delay, seizures, characteristic craniofacial dysmorphism, and pathogenic ZMYND11 variant
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by molecular genetic testing identifying pathogenic variants in ZMYND11.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Global developmental delay with prominent speech delay
searchTerms: delayed overall development with speech problems
slow developmental milestones and speech delay
global developmental lag including talking delay

pathognomonic.symptomName: Seizures of variable type and severity
searchTerms: seizures of different types and severity

pathognomonic.symptomName: Characteristic craniofacial dysmorphism including microcephaly and prominent nasal bridge
searchTerms: distinct facial features including small head and prominent nose bridge
unusual head shape with noticeable nasal bridge

common.symptomName: Behavioral abnormalities including autistic features and hyperactivity
searchTerms: behavior problems including autism and hyperactivity

common.symptomName: Intellectual disability ranging from mild to severe
searchTerms: learning difficulties from mild to severe

occasional.symptomName: Skeletal anomalies such as scoliosis or joint hypermobility
searchTerms: bone abnormalities like curved spine or loose joints
skeletal issues such as scoliosis or joint laxity

imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific cerebral atrophy or delayed myelination
genetic: Pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in ZMYND11 gene detected by sequencing
other: EEG abnormalities consistent with seizure activity

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic happy demeanor and frequent laughter

redFlags: Early onset seizures refractory to treatment
Severe global developmental delay with absent speech
references: Recent literature: Deciphering the phenotypic spectrum of ZMYND11 mutations, 2023
